specials.title: Red Dog Specials
specials.description:
Soup:
Mexican Pork Pozole ... 6 (cup) or 8 (bowl)
Soup with hominy and tender pork cooked in a mild red chile broth, garnished with crunchy fresh toppings

Appetizer:
Chile Con Queso ... 13
Homemade, from scratch chile con queso made with fresh ingredients. Served with deep fried tortillas.

Entrées:
Pan Seared Scallops ... 40
Large sea scallops sautéed in lemon caper sauce and served over pasta.
Add she crab soup on top ... 8

Ribeye Fajita Tacos ... 22
Seasoned ribeye steak sautéed with peppers and onions, wrapped in warm tortillas topped with pico de gallo and sour cream

Hot Italian Hero/Sub ... 16
Sliced pastrami, salami, Black Forest ham and provolone topped with lettuce, tomato, onion tossed in our housemade red wine vinaigrette and hot cherry peppers. Served with fries.

Pan Seared Rainbow Trout ... 27
Trout, seasoned with Italian herbs then pan seared in garlic lemon butter sauce, served with fingerling potatoes and grilled asparagus.

LUNCH SPECIALS
Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM

Goat Cheese Burger ... 15
Grilled beef patty topped with creamy, tangy goat cheese, caramelized onions and red pepper jelly on a toasted Brioche bun.

Fried Buffalo Chicken Sandwich ... 13
Buttermilk, dill pickle brined chicken breast, breaded, fried, and tossed in buffalo sauce. Served on a toasted bun with dilly blue cheese
